name: prime-workflow
description: Prime multi-agent autopilot for Codex and Claude Code: a reviewed plan, one git worktree per feature with port/env/DB isolation, a lint/typecheck/test + reviewer gate before merge, dry-run merge and cleanup scripts, SDLC phases with exit criteria; Context7 and Perplexity MCP (both optional, with web search fallback).

interface.shortDescription: Autopilot: plan, build in worktrees, check, review, merge
interface.longDescription: Turns a goal into a reviewed plan, then drives it with the prime-run.mjs harness: isolated git worktrees per stream, a lint/typecheck/test gate plus a recorded review verdict, a local merge in plan order and a final verify of the base. It never pushes. Each SDLC phase has an exit criterion before the next one starts.
defaultPrompt: Build this with Prime on autopilot.
Plan this goal with Prime and wait for my OK.
Run the Prime review gate on this branch.
Show the Prime merge order and predicted conflicts.
